result.summary: The page is largely well-structured, but one restaurant card in the 'Popular right now' section shows a broken/missing image placeholder instead of an actual photo, which is the main visual defect.

issues.description: The 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card in the 'Popular right now' section displays a gray broken-image placeholder icon instead of a restaurant photo, while other cards show proper images.
issues.suggestion: Load the correct restaurant image; if the image fails to load, show a branded fallback (e.g., logo or colored placeholder with the restaurant name) rather than a generic broken-image icon.

issues.description: The broken-image card's gray empty area looks visually inconsistent with the rich photo cards above and below it, creating an unbalanced layout.
issues.suggestion: Ensure all cards in the vertical list have consistent image aspect ratios and a graceful loading/error state so the section looks uniform.
